answer_1.quote: We validate the effectiveness of our approaches on two important generation tasks: question generation and data-to-text generation... For question generation, we present results on the SQuAD QG dataset... for data-to-text NLG, we choose the WebNLG dataset.
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language questions and textual descriptions of RDF triples

answer_2.quote: We report on evaluation metrics including BLEU-4, METEOR, ROUGE-L, Q-BLEU1 , as well as QPP and QAP... For data-to-text we use BLEU, ROUGE-L, and Entailment-Score as rewards.

answer_4.quote: We performed anonymous human evaluation studies using Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk)... we asked the annotators to rate the quality of the generated outputs based on relevance and coherence on a 5-point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated output for relevance and coherence using a 5-point Likert scale.
